author: Lasuz
body:
Application

Age: 14 1/2

Timezone: GMT+1

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? No.  


What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? Most likely school. Some weeks I might not be so active as expected. My biggest strength is probably me being available on discord / slack nearly 24/7, besides when i’m sleeping (like 5 hours in weekends). I’m online on discord at school and in class, so… :>

I would love to become a part of the staff team on Avicus, because I want to help the server with catching hackers, help the people that needs help, and get to know the staff team! I think everyone in the staff team is quite nice (at least they I know or have seen sometimes on the server), and I would love to get to know you guys!

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

I can ban people through Minechat at school if someone got proof posted on the forums, when there is no other mods available.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

A leader needs to be able to make decisions, but also listen to other people. Also not laughing of others mistake, but rather telling them what the right thing to say is. I think i’m decent at being a leader.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

I’m good at catching hackers, and making decisions. I am a really nice person, and really care about other’s. Let’s say; someone in the chat says “You suck at this game” to someone who just joined the server, I always step in and ask them to stop saying things like that. Often I also msg the person they send it to, and tell him/her not to listen to them, and that you are doing great for one that just joined the server. If someone is behaving bad to fellow players, and I know it’s not friendly, I feel really bad for them, even after I have told what I just wrote. I always think of the worst possible dilemma, like: What if someone him/her knew died today (maybe not that serious, but something like that), and then he/she just logged in here to get bullied? Of course most likely it didn’t happen, but in a way I feel I have to treat them like I that. I think it’s a good thing, because then I have a reason to always be nice!

And to be honest Avicus need more mods that can be active over time - and not only the first month.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

You should be able to be nice to everyone - no matter what they’ve done to you, and also make hard decisions fast under pressure.  I think I have those qualities.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?

Depends from week to week, but maybe around 1 hour per day (more in weekends) without discord / slack / minechat.

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

I would attempt to kick as many alts as I am able too. I would ask for help in the staff Discord or ask a senior staff member to ban them.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

I would privately message the referee and request that he stop. If he did not, I would collect evidence in the form of screenshots or a video and then kick him and report him to the seniors.  


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

I would talk to a senior about my belief that the player was breaking the rules. I would then leave it up to their judgement.


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

I would privately message the staff member in question and tell them to delete it. If they did not, I would inform the seniors on what they did.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

I would discuss the issue  with a senior staff member and raise my concerns. I would also ask for more information on the decision. If I still did not agree with the decision, I would make it clear that I do not like the decision but am willing to set aside my personal disagreement with the decision so long as it does not conflict with my personal values.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.




What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

A lot. There is no other way to describe it.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

Avicus is the only place I want to be when I feel really sad, glad, happy, or angry. There is no such place in the rest of the world.


Do you speak any other languages than English?

I speak English, Norwegian and a bit spanish :)


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

Nothing special.


Good luck to those applying

- Senior Staff.
